issues.title: Explicit symmetric Meld is blocked by an unrelated embedded grant
issues.expected: A direct symmetric Meld evaluates only its two explicit advisor peers and fresh Result, then stops at any equal-authority decision gate.
issues.actual: All five distinct advisor-pair Melds failed before comparison because task-2/description contains an unrelated advisor1/budget Embed, even when neither that Context nor description was an endpoint.
issues.workaround: Use explicit pairwise Compare/Query evidence and leave the synthesis unapplied; removing the unrelated Embed would mutate the study fixture.

issues.title: Rationale provenance silently switches to Chinese
issues.expected: Rationale preserves the command/session language unless the person asks for translation.
issues.actual: Attempt 3 rendered the English Memory normally but synthesized its entire 80-character provenance sentence in Chinese.
issues.workaround: Use Trace JSON for language-neutral retained evidence and ignore the synthesized prose.

issues.title: Applied Update checkpoint cannot be correlated by Trace
issues.expected: An applied cross-Context Update writes valid command-unit metadata so later Trace can correlate its Memory changes and recovery point.
issues.actual: Update attempt 1 applied one addition and created checkpoint e8f7aaa4, but Trace attempts 3 and 5 warned that this checkpoint has invalid Update command-unit metadata and its changes cannot be correlated across Contexts.
issues.workaround: Correlate update receipt f451a277 and checkpoint e8f7aaa4 manually; do not treat the later Trace as a complete cross-Context lineage.

issues.title: Study harness did not consume short checkpoint receipts
issues.expected: The study harness carries each successful checkpoint selector into its subsequent Diff and Revert commands.
issues.actual: Checkpoint printed an accepted eight-character selector in brackets, but the harness looked only for a full UID inside a recovery command. It sent 00000000 to five Diffs and four intended Reverts, which failed safely.
issues.workaround: Parse the bracketed checkpoint prefix before constructing recovery argv; the five durable checkpoints themselves remain in the isolated Store.
